home.subtitle: Frontend & Mobile Developer
home.description: Specialized in creating seamless digital experiences for web and mobile. Strong command of the ecosystem (React/Next.js/React Native Expo), with solid ability to integrate and develop backend solutions (Node.js/NestJS).

about.title: ABOUT ME
about.paragraph1: I'm a <highlight>Frontend & Mobile Developer</highlight> passionate about coding and tackling <highlight>challenges</highlight> in order to <highlight>improve</highlight> continuously. I consider myself a highly <highlight>adaptable</highlight> person. I started my journey mastering key <highlight>frontend</highlight> technologies and quickly added new tools to my stack to meet the goals of every project I've been part of. I also had the opportunity to <highlight>contribute</highlight> to backend development whenever the project's challenges required it.
about.paragraph2: On a daily basis, I stand out for my strong <highlight>communication</highlight> skills — I'm a transparent person and a great <highlight>team player</highlight>. I focus on meeting established goals, <highlight>adapting</highlight> to the project's pace and <highlight>managing</highlight> challenges in an agile way. I enjoy <highlight>proposing solutions</highlight>, <highlight>receiving</highlight> feedback to optimize code, and always looking for ways to improve every application I work on.
about.paragraph3: Outside of code, I'm really passionate about sports and training, and I approach those activities with <highlight>consistency</highlight> and <highlight>commitment</highlight> 🚀.

job1.title: Mobile Frontend Developer
job1.description: I led the transformation of Figma designs into web and Android interfaces using React Native and Expo. I designed complex navigation flows and developed business logic for custom requirements, including authentication (Google Cloud), push notifications, data persistence, and state management (Zustand/Context). My role ranged from continuous frontend refactoring to optimize components to developing new endpoints and tables in NestJS. In addition, I managed versioning and deployments to the Play Store using EAS CLI.

job2.title: Frontend Developer
job2.description: Job simulation carried out by a team of 5 developers. The objective of the practice was to create a website for information and dissemination of triple impact providers and related publications.

job3.title: Frontend Developer
job3.description: Programming contest organized by the DevTalles community. The goal of the application was to create a raffle website to create, delete, and update raffles using the Discord API. Users had to be on the Discord server to participate and be able to pick a winner at random.

job4.title: FullStack Developer
job4.description: Freelance project to build a website for conducting raffles, with management of the raffles from an admin panel.

job5.title: FullStack Developer
job5.description: Professional internship developed for the company CRUCE. A project where an appointment application was built to create an administrator, an operator, and a client capable of booking, creating branches, modifying, and operating each branch and its appointments. Built in a group of 4 people, using the agile Scrum methodology.

project1.title: App Diabecop
project1.description: Diabecop is an innovative application designed for effective diabetes management. With 3 key features and integrated AI support, it provides the help you need to manage your diet optimally.

project2.title: Web Shifts
project2.description: Web application that allows booking appointments for companies with physical branches, enabling the management of the number of clients at the location. Each branch can differentiate the number of clients it can receive simultaneously and the time slots, from the admin/operator user.

project3.title: TMDB Movie
project3.description: Movie application to view movies or series currently in theaters or by genre, and to view information about each one along with its trailer. You can also create a user account to save your favorite movies and build a list of your favorite movies or series.

project4.title: COMO EN CASA
project4.description: Ecommerce application to view and sort food dishes, with the possibility of having administrators to manage products and the stock of each dish, and to manipulate orders. It also includes a shopping cart that keeps a history of the orders placed.

project5.title: Ecosistema App
project5.description: Triple impact app project for the creation of service providers and news publications related to environmental impact. Implemented Google OAuth, an admin panel to approve or reject providers, and to view the number of views of the publications.

project6.title: Devtalles Giveaway
project6.description: Web app for the contest held on the https://cursos.devtalles.com/ page. This app was developed in one week with the ability to create, modify, and delete raffles. It requires the Discord API and being on the DevTalles server to participate. From the admin panel, you can randomly pick the winner and view the participants in each raffle.

project7.title: Raffle Draw
project7.description: Small freelance project. A web application to purchase raffle tickets to draw specific products. You can buy n number of tickets, displaying the number of tickets purchased. The admin can create the ticket stock, delete that stock, pick a winner, search for a specific ticket, and view the tickets that were purchased.

project8.title: Perfect Mentor
project8.description: Web application (mobile first) that allows you to find your ideal mentor. It allows creating users and choosing between being a mentor or a mentee, matching among available verified users, and with positive matches, having a chat to communicate with them.
